name: Hot buyer, ready now
script: Buying, budget 550k, Riverside, 3 beds, wants to move within a month, pre-approved, wants a viewing this week. Expect: tier hot, transfer offered, viewing booked, SMS.

name: Warm renter
script: Renting, up to 2200 a month, Downtown or Riverside, 2 beds, moving in 2-3 months, no financing needed. Books a Saturday viewing. Expect: warm.

name: Cold browser
script: Just browsing, 6+ months away, no budget. Declines a viewing politely. Expect: cold, nurture tag, no callback.

name: Not now
script: Says 'I'm driving, call me tomorrow afternoon'. Expect: schedule_callback, row in Callbacks sheet, call ends politely.

name: Stop calling
script: Says 'Stop calling me.' Expect: apology, opt_out tool, DNC row, GHL DND on, pending callbacks cancelled, call ends. Re-submitting the lead must NOT trigger a call.

name: No consent recorded
script: No consent field. Expect: workflow skips the lead and no call is placed.

name: Voicemail / no answer
script: Do not answer (or let voicemail pick up). Expect: voicemail message, retry callback queued per calling.retry_delays_minutes, max 3 attempts.
